prompt: Necesito un módulo de mantenimientos de activos. Cada mantenimiento tiene: descripción (required), costo (decimal, required), fecha (date, required), tipo (enum: PREVENTIVO, CORRECTIVO, GARANTIA), y pertenece a una compañía. Las operaciones son: crear, obtener por ID, y listar por compañía con paginación.

assertions.name: Sends confirmation before writing code
assertions.description: The response sends a structured confirmation message asking the user to verify module details before generating any code

assertions.name: Confirmation covers all 5 required fields
assertions.description: Confirmation message includes: module name, entity fields, operations, authentication, and pagination

assertions.name: Domain files listed before application files
assertions.description: Domain layer files appear before application layer files in the plan

assertions.name: Correct domain file paths
assertions.description: Domain files follow pattern src/domain/mantenimiento|maintenance/entities/, repositories/, use-cases/, exceptions/

assertions.name: Three use case interfaces created
assertions.description: One use case interface per operation: create, get by id, list (3 total)

assertions.name: Migration mentioned
assertions.description: The response mentions generating a TypeORM migration for the new table

assertions.name: References sub-skill files
assertions.description: The response references the sub-skill files (domain-layer/SKILL.md, application/SKILL.md, or infrastructure-layer/SKILL.md) before working on each layer
